articles.title: What crypto investors need to know about the wash-sale rule
articles.mainIdea: What crypto investors need to know about the wash-sale rule
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: What crypto investors need to know about the wash-sale rule. Charles Schwab defines a wash sale as "when you sell a security at a loss for the tax benefits but then turn around and buy the same or a similar security." The IRS has rules about wash sales, but, at the end of 2025, these rules don't apply to cryptocurrencies (but they may apply to crypto exchange-traded products). Claris Financial Advisors founder Lee Baker shares what crypto investors need to know about the wash-sale rule.
